tweets.text: It was great to be in Berlin and Zurich last week to connect with the European scientific community and policymakers on the urgent need for safe-by-design AI.

What a week in Berlin and Zurich! We connected with researchers, policymakers and industry leaders in AI safety, and shared how LawZero is working to solve AI misalignment and ensure this technology remains safe and under human control.\
